items.title: Don Albert Interview, 1961-05-11
items.q: The interviewer states 'your uncle, Natty Dominic', but the interviewee only confirms his own name is Dominic and does not elaborate on the relationship or interaction with Natty Dominic.

ctx.x: He was born the same day as your uncle, Natty Dominic. Dominic. Oh, you might mention your name originally was Dominic.
My name is Dominic. I use it, but my professional name is Don Albert. The last part's always added for writing checks. It's still legally then your name. That's right. My name is Dominic.
Do you mind telling a little bit about your teachers or how you got started in music?
